_howto: Callouts for the build-by-number scrum. side = where the callout sits on wide screens (left, right, top, bottom).

players.name: Loosehead Prop
players.text: Head goes outside the opposing tighthead. Bind on your hooker.

players.name: Hooker
players.text: Head goes between your two props. Bind over both props. You hook the ball back.

players.name: Tighthead Prop
players.text: Head goes between the opposing loosehead and hooker. Bind on your hooker.

players.name: Lock
players.text: Head goes in the gap between your hooker and loosehead. Shoulders on the prop's and hooker's hips. Bind with the other lock.

players.name: Lock
players.text: Head goes in the gap between your hooker and tighthead. Shoulders on the hips. Bind with the other lock.

players.name: Flanker
players.text: Bind on the outside of a lock. Shoulder on the prop. Be ready to get off fast on defense.

players.name: Flanker
players.text: Same as 6 on the other side. Get off quickly and pressure the opposition.

players.name: Number Eight
players.text: Head goes between your two locks. You control the ball at the base.

notInScrum.9: The 9 isn't bound in the scrum. They put the ball in, then follow it to the back to play it.
notInScrum.backs: Backs aren't in the scrum. They stand back, at least 5 meters behind the back foot of the scrum, until the ball is out.
